# netactuate_vpc_ssh_key (Resource)

Manages a VPC SSH Key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc_ssh_key" "example" {
  ssh_key_id = 12345
  vpc_id     = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ssh_key_id` (Number) The account-level SSH key ID
- `vpc_id` (Number) The ID of the VPC

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the SSH key is enabled for this VPC (default: true)

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) The fingerprint of the SSH key
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) The name of the SSH key
- `public_key` (String) The public key

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc_ssh_key.example 12345
```
